definition: MutuallyLike demands Like x y for each distinct ordered pair of members of a list, in the selected resemblance respect. It does not assert transitivity, ordinary F-predication, copying, or identity.
note: Explicit semantic boundary for issue #258. The cited primary readings motivate research premises without defining this modern finite-list encoding. A sourced replacement would need to settle precisely these quantifiers, domains and predication senses.
